items.description: E2 UAS Aircraft including avionics, ground station
Engineering support for control law modifications

notes: Quote for E2 UAS with training, simulation, and engineering support sent 10/31/2025 for $56k. Customer (Bruce Cogan, retired NASA, managing Cal State Northridge research proposal) requested urgent quote for VTOL with 2-way communication capability and flight controller customization. Project is in early stage pending customer acceptance and funding approval.
